daim-review-daim.service.content:
[Unit]
Description=DAIM review isolated daim
After=network.target openvswitch-switch.service
[Service]
Type=simple
User=ubuntu
WorkingDirectory=/home/ubuntu/review_campaign
Environment="PATH=/home/ubuntu/daim_venv/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
Environment="DAIM_ADAPTER_MODE=process_per_rule"
Environment="DAIM_BRIDGE_MAP=/home/ubuntu/review_campaign/bridge_map.json"
ExecStart=/home/ubuntu/daim_venv/bin/osken-manager /home/ubuntu/review_campaign/network/r5_daim_service_controller.py --ofp-tcp-listen-port 6653
CPUAccounting=yes
MemoryAccounting=yes
MemoryMax=2500M
TasksMax=4096
TimeoutStopSec=20
KillMode=control-group
Restart=no
